Explore LCFR [SOLD OUT] Nergal of Behemoth signature Explore Paranormal II [SOLD OUT] Gary Holt Gary Holt Parametric EQ Overdrive vol.2 Explore Ascendancy by Trivium [SOLD OUT] Dual Pedal for Matthew and Corey of Trivium Explore Unicorn Blood II Limited edition octave fuzz 2020 Explore Unicorn Blood [SOLD OUT] Limited edition octave fuzz 2018 Explore Paranormal [SOLD OUT] Gary Holt Parametric EQ Overdrive Explore Scuzz Box Germanium-voiced fuzz with a gnarly 8-bit twist Explore Abyss A game changing bass overdrive Explore No.1 A tube-like overdriven amp on your pedalboard Explore Fallout Bass Overdrive by Dave Ellefson of Megadeth Explore No.2 Much more than a precision clean boost Explore Ghoul JR Little is the New Lethal Cost: $ 149.95 Hyper Powerful Mini Overdrive GHOUL JR is a hyper powerful overdrive circuit coiled inside a micro-sized box. It's the evil little brother of our Ghoul Screamer, featuring its most used settings in half the size and twice the gain. Yes, it goes past 11. This workhorse delivers massive overdrive with a wide range of colors from fuzzy vintage treble boost to creamy, liquid tone. The haunting ghoulish face on the enclosure was hand-drawn by San Fran's tattoo wizard Tim Lehi. New 'Balls to the Wall' Mode We’ve added a brand new full-on mode for even more powerful cut-through sound. Look for it with the Style switch in ‘down’ setting. As put it: "Flick the Style switch down and wreak havoc!" This ghoulie is powerful enough to be your main overdrive and also works great for boosting an already overdriven amp or to bring out the best of its neighbors on a pedalboard. Remember: the usual gain range is 1 to 10, but GHOUL JR will take you all the way to 12! VOLUME Controls the overall output volume of GHOUL JR. TONE A highly effective active high-frequency tone

KHDK Electronics Ghoul JR Kirk Hammett Signature Overdrive quantity Add to cart SKU: 221124396914008 Category: hot sale Tag: KHDK Electronics Description Manufacturer’s ID: 10003747 Hyper Powerful Mini Overdrive GHOUL JR is a hyper powerful overdrive circuit coiled inside a micro-sized box. It’s the evil little brother of our Ghoul Screamer, featuring its most used settings in half the size and twice the gain. Yes, it goes past 11. This workhorse delivers massive overdrive with a wide range of colors from fuzzy vintage treble boost to creamy, liquid tone. The haunting ghoulish face on the enclosure was hand-drawn by San Fran’s tattoo wizard Tim Lehi. New ‘Balls to the Wall’ Mode We’ve added a brand new full-on mode for even more powerful cut-through sound. Look for it with the Style switch in ‘down’ setting. As put it: “Flick the Style switch down and wreak havoc!” This ghoulie is powerful enough to be your main overdrive and also works great for boosting an already overdriven amp or to bring out the best of its neighbors on a pedalboard. Specification Bypass mode True Bypass Dimensions (Width x Depth x Height) 92 mm x 38 mm x 28 mm deep Input Connector Type Standard ¼” jack – mono/TS Output Connector Type Standard ¼” jack – mono/TS Power Input 9V DC (center negative) power supply. Power GHOUL JR is powered exclusively by external 9V DC (center negative) power supply. Controls DRIVE Controls the gain of the circuit. On lower Drive settings, GHOUL JR works as a clean boost with a characteristic mid hump. For more distortion turn the Drive control higher to increase the harmonics, compression and power. Remember: the usual gain range is 1 to 10, but GHOUL JR will take you all the way to 12! VOLUME Controls the overall output volume of GHOUL JR. TONE A highly effective active high-frequency tone control. At 12 o’clock it’s neutral. Turned clockwise it becomes raw, aggressive and helps your tone cut through. Turned counterclockwise it cuts the highs for a more mellow, warm tone. VOICE Is your Bass and Body control.CENTER is the basic setting. UP enhances low frequencies to thicken your tone and add massive bottom end, while DOWN improves the tonal response in the mids as well as tone tightness and cut-through, particularly effective with low tuned guitars. STYLE Delivers three levels of gain and headroom. UP is your basic setting, with the most compressed classic sound. CENTER brings a more dynamic, cutting tone. DOWN is a brand new full-on mode with the most aggressive, fullest setting and a bonus dose of gain for even bigger sustain and cut-through. FOOTSWITCH Engages your GHOUL JR to “on” or True bypass mode.
